cases.title: A diameter-only save in Edit Pipe keeps the flow arrow where it was, also on a pipe whose levels were typed the other way round
cases.plan_item: Edit Pipe single save (triage group K3; daily card D17 neighbour); BUG-292 (a plain Save reversing a downstream-first pipe), BUG-261 (size-only save of a reversed two-free-end pipe), BUG-260 (arrow and levels disagree)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-292 (a downstream-first pipe could be reversed by a plain Save), BUG-261 (size-only save of a two-free-end pipe whose arrow follows the levels) and BUG-260 (arrow, labels and header disagree) as written in BUG_CARPARK.md. The reversed state is reached through Edit Pipe, not through the CD direction question as in BUG-261, so this case is a close match, not an exact one: the desk or the reviewer decides whether BUG-292 or a new entry owns it.
cases.expected: Pipe A (two free ends, 18.000 / 17.900) is edited to 17.900 / 18.000 (arrow turns round, rotation about 3.1416). A second CDEDIT of pipe A that changes only the diameter to 150 and saves prints "Pipe updated.", leaves the arrow turned round (rotation about 3.1416), both IL texts as they were (IL 17.900 left, IL 18.000 right) and the label reading "150 DIA.". Control: pipe B (never reversed) keeps its arrow at rotation 0 on the same diameter-only save. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The arrow block, the IL texts and the label are rewritten by the live Edit Pipe save into the real drawing.
not_automated: That the picture of the arrow looks right is a Codex look. Pipes on pits (levels from the pits) are not driven.

cases.proves_bugs: BUG-460 (PIT with the pit label layer locked, and again with the cover-text layer locked, is refused before the pit goes in: the New Pit window opens, Continue placement is pressed, CE says the pit was not inserted and names the layer, and the drawing object count does not move); BUG-672 (COPY of a pit with only the cover-text layer locked: the copy keeps its own pit number label, and CE reports the one thing skipped, the cover text, naming layer 25TEXT); BUG-262 (the wording half only: the schedule-cell lines name the pit, the column and the layer; the handle-only lines, the copied-cell line and the invert-text-layer line are not driven)
cases.title: With a pit text layer locked, PIT refuses before placing anything and COPY of a pit keeps its number label, names the cover-text layer it skipped, and one U takes the copy back
cases.plan_item: Native protection rule: locked pit text layers (triage group L1); BUG-460, BUG-672, BUG-262 (schedule-cell wording half)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-460 (right result: refused before the pit goes in, like a locked pit layer), BUG-672 (expected: copy what sits on open layers and report the one skipped) and BUG-262 (expected: plain names of pit, layer and schedule column) as written in BUG_CARPARK.md. Not claimed: BUG-458 (REFEDIT), BUG-459 and BUG-565 (Edit Pit on locked text layers: the Edit Pit Save button is not on the driver's press list), BUG-312.
cases.expected: With the layer STORMWATER PIT LABEL locked, PIT at 150000,-80000 with cover level 19.000 and Continue placement prints "Pit not inserted - layer 'STORMWATER PIT LABEL' is locked" and the object count is unchanged. After unlocking it and locking 25TEXT, COPY of pit P3 prints "1 pit copied and numbered as new", then says the copied pit got its own number but no label or cover text because layer 25TEXT is locked, and names the schedule cells it could not update with the pit, the column and the layer. The copy is one new pit block on STORMWATER PIT and one new PIT LABEL block on STORMWATER PIT LABEL, no new "CL" text, and one U brings the object count back to what it was before the COPY. PIT at 156000,-80000 with 25TEXT locked prints "Pit not inserted - layer '25TEXT' is locked." and the object count is unchanged. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: It needs AutoCAD's real layer lock, the real New Pit window and the real COPY clean-up.
not_automated: That the layers are STILL locked afterwards is shown only by the refusals; the layer lock flag itself is not read (the case unlocks them with AutoCAD's own -LAYER Unlock between parts).
The Pit Schedule drawn cells (BUG-246, BUG-312) and Edit Pit with a locked label layer (BUG-459, BUG-565) are not driven.
